# Build the dummy Dockerfile
exec docker build -qt dummy-updater .

# Run the dependabot command - should call both fetch and update
dependabot update go_modules dependabot/cli --updater-image dummy-updater

# assert the dummy is working
stderr 'bin/run arguments: fetch_files'
stderr 'bin/run arguments: update_files'

exec docker rmi -f dummy-updater

-- Dockerfile --
FROM ubuntu:24.04

RUN useradd -m dependabot && \
    mkdir -p /home/dependabot && \
    chown dependabot:dependabot /home/dependabot

COPY --chown=dependabot:dependabot --chmod=755 update-ca-certificates /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates
COPY --chown=dependabot:dependabot --chmod=755 run bin/run

USER dependabot
WORKDIR /home/dependabot

-- update-ca-certificates --
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
echo "Updated those certificates for ya"

-- run --
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
echo "bin/run arguments: $@"
echo "pwd: $(pwd)" >&2
echo "whoami: $(whoami)" >&2
